# Crafting recipe finder
[textlink="Back to Mining & Industry" link="CMUGuideIndustry"]
[bold]What are we building?[/bold] Search for an item or a material, select a recipe, then choose how many crafts to pack for. Every hand-crafting recipe is visible here, even if you do not yet have its materials or skills.
[bold]Ready to make it?[/bold] Carry the supplies and right-click yourself → Craft. The planner shows base quantities; crafting challenges can change the result. Machine windows list their own recipes; choose anvil recipes on a hot workpiece.
